title: Judge verdict
description: The answer of the AI judge on one evaluation result: how well the actual answer matches the expected answer, why, and what should change in the data or the prompt.

verdict.description: pass: the answer is correct and complete; mostly_pass: correct with minor gaps; mostly_fail: substantial errors or omissions; fail: wrong, missing or misleading.

reasoning.description: Why the verdict was given, comparing the actual with the expected answer.

suggestions.description: Improvements; empty when nothing should change.

type.description: data: the knowledge base (documents, collections, tools) lacks or misstates something; prompt: the agent's instructions should change.

category.description: Short label for grouping, e.g. missing-document or answer-format.
